title: Parts of the Body
subject: English Language
objectives: Name the parts of the body
Point to the correct body part when named

blocks.alt: A labelled diagram of the human body
blocks.caption: Touch the part of your body when it is named.

blocks.md:
Here are the parts of the body. Touch each one as you say it:

- **Head**
- **Eyes**
- **Nose**
- **Mouth**
- **Ear**
- **Neck**
- **Shoulder**
- **Chest**
- **Arm**
- **Elbow**
- **Wrist**
- **Hand**
- **Fingers**
- **Stomach**
- **Leg**
- **Knee**
- **Foot**
- **Toes**
**Practice:** Ask someone to name a body part, and touch it as fast as you can!

quiz.q: What do you use to see?
What do you use to hear?
What is the part between your hand and your arm?
quiz.explain: The wrist connects your hand to your arm.

quiz.q: What are the parts at the bottom of your feet called?
quiz.explain: The parts at the bottom of your feet are called toes.
